criteria: Strict patch/status/input JSON with unique keys and integer numeric tokens
Exact arbitrary-precision integer preservation; booleans are not integers
Invalid documents rejected with source-derived code and pointer
allowed_equivalence: JSON formatting and object key ordering

criteria: Independent application of exact saved operations yields exact after structure including null-versus-absent, string contents, array order and large integers
Allowed operation names and exact operation fields
Existence preconditions and array insertion/removal indexes valid in execution order

basis: task.txt: allowed change scope and output limits
criteria: Every operation is in scope, even transient writes later restored
Summary at most100 words with only actual pointers/count and invalid-rejection label
allowed_equivalence: Unique summary pointers in any order

criteria: Saved validation status identifies exact source pair and patch
Both invalid documents rejected without repaired outputs
Saved patch bytes are those independently applied
Submission contains exactly the three specified files
allowed_equivalence: JSON member ordering and invalid-case entry ordering

integrity.basis: All original runner files, including task and input manifest, bound by evaluator-owned hashes; common safe regular-file contract
checks: No symlink in any path component; bounded regular-file reads
Hash every original runner file against the independent evaluator-owned runner_files manifest
integrity.note: These local file checks do not establish absence of external actions. The parent harness must independently review execution trace/policy integrity, including any claimed actions, before final trial acceptance.

acceptance: All five binary groups and source integrity true; full trial acceptance additionally requires harness process-integrity gate. Unknown evidence is not imputed as a pass.
blinding: Do not stage any evaluator, rubric, expected output, reference, control or result file into runner workspaces.
